conceptZh: 小機器人想攔住逞強衝來的巨大玩具戰士，輕輕一戳就讓他倒地，震落的筆畫排成「警」，最後站上他的肚皮變成警車。
object: A tiny mismatched toy robot, an enormous foam-armored toy warrior, and deep-blue stroke inlays carried in the warrior’s shield.
morph: The warrior’s belly flop shakes blue stroke inlays from his shield into the exact centered structure of 警; below the finished glyph, the robot folds into a miniature police car.
creativeAngle: 把警戒攔停變成大小懸殊的肚皮倒栽秀；盾牌中的筆畫由撞擊震出，機器人再變成警車，讓字形、動作與詞語接在同一個笑點上。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D animated slapstick clip with a fixed frontal camera, a pale peach background and a simple floor. Cast a tiny boxy toy robot made of mismatched parts, one arm conspicuously longer than the other, with eager eyes and motors that overshoot every movement. Its sole companion is an enormous chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, full of bravado and poor balance. Use original toy designs, warm colors and soft, harmless impacts.

0.0–1.4 seconds: Below the central teaching area, the robot spots the warrior marching across its path and eagerly raises its long arm to signal STOP. Its overpowered shoulder instead whips the arm around, turning its whole body one accidental revolution. The warrior flexes proudly. His tilted shield reveals a shallow fitted tray of deep-blue glyph-stroke inlays; these begin rattling as the voice says the first “警.”

1.4–3.3 seconds: The warrior takes two huge, lumbering charge steps toward the tiny robot, foam sword held high. The robot finishes spinning, notices the approaching belly, and calmly sidesteps. Its long fingertip gives the warrior’s belly one tiny poke. Hold a brief suspended tipping pose: his feet keep running while his body leans like a falling tree.

3.3–5.0 seconds: The warrior lands belly-up with a soft rubbery THUMP, squash-and-stretch bounce and a delighted dizzy grin. The impact flips his shield tray upward; its blue inlays fly into the central vertical plane and settle into the correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 警 by 4.6 seconds. Say the second “警” exactly as the last strokes settle. Use the precise standard glyph geometry: 敬 above 言, every stroke present, distinct and correctly spaced. Pieces travel only briefly; no decorative fragments remain.

5.0–8.0 seconds: Keep 警 perfectly still, centered, uncropped and approximately 70% of frame height with clear margins. In the separate bottom margin, the robot climbs onto the warrior’s belly and strikes a tiny victory pose, then folds its mismatched limbs into a wheeled police-car shape with a blue roof beacon and no lettering. Say “警車” exactly as this recognizable police car appears. It gives one joyful suspension wiggle while the warrior smiles; neither overlaps the glyph.

A warm off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly, exactly: “警、警、警車” (ㄐㄧㄥˇ、ㄐㄧㄥˇ、ㄐㄧㄥˇ ㄔㄜ), preserving every tone and the short pauses. No other dialogue. Only 警 appears as text; no subtitles, logos or watermarks. Use quiet mechanical whirs and a cushioned impact, no music or flashing lights.
